To distinguish between the two, one can employ critical thinking and seek evidence. Peer review and replication of results are also key in establishing objective truths, as they help ensure that findings are not merely subjective interpretations.

In essence, while subjective perceptions are valuable for personal insight and understanding, objective truths provide a common ground for shared knowledge and understanding, grounded in evidence and reason.
